release_notes: Build 149 removes the retired Pixabay and Pexels compatibility providers from the quiz-only desktop app.
API & Connections no longer advertises or tests stock-image provider credentials that Factburst no longer uses.
Active OpenAI, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram and website connections remain unchanged.
Legacy stock-provider settings remain migration-compatible until the old hidden XAML shell is removed in the next cleanup build.
